verdict.rationale: Alacritty's docs say URLs can be opened by mouse click, with configurable modifiers and opener program. Its regex hints let users mark any text for mouse or keyboard interaction without entering vi mode, which covers the click and keyboard paths for URLs. The evidence never says file paths are detected or opened, and never states that keyboard hints launch an opener. Missing for 10: explicit file-path detection/opening, documented keyboard-driven open action via hints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open URLs and file paths from output by clicking them or selecting them from the keyboard

citations.quote: You can open URLs with your mouse by clicking on them. The modifiers required to be held and program which should open the URL can be setup in the configuration file.
Regex Hints — Mark any text for mouse or keyboard interaction
Terminal hints allow easily interacting with visible text without having to start vi mode.
